'''Damian''' is a receptionist of Sorrentino Inn, owned by his uncle, [[Cosimo]] Sorrentino. Like many youths of Egla town, he also idolized knights. He is childhood friends with [[Carlow]]. 


==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Damian:''' Hello, friend from afar, and welcome to the Sorrentino Inn.
:'''Damian:''' I'm Damian, the receptionist, but also the acting innkeeper for now. We currently have several rooms available, and you're welcome to stay anytime.
:{{DIcon}} Could you tell me about this inn?
::'''Damian:''' Certainly! The Sorrentino Inn is century-old establishment in Egla Town, currently owned by Mr. Cosimo Sorrentino.
::'''Damian:''' The inn features decor that reflects the unique style of Egla Town, offering guests aromatic dried herbs from the [[Fagaceae Peninsula]] and sweet treats falvored with [[Viscum Berry|Viscum Berries]]. By the way, during the Carnevale, we provide shuttle  services to and from Ragunna City, and long-term stays come with additional discounts. 
::'''Damian:''' In addition, we offer a signature breakfast service featuring freshly baked bread and cheese from [[Burrata Bakery]] each morning.
:{{DIcon}} Why did you become the receptionist here?
::'''Damian:''' Cosimo is my uncle and the owner of this inn. Have you had the chance to meet him yet?
::'''Damian:''' As for why... Perhaps it's just like that line from the knight's tale...
::'''Damian:''' "I may not have dreams of my own, but I can protect the dreams of others."
::'''Damian:''' My calling is to fulfill my duties and provide others with an excellent experience staying here.
:{{DIcon}} Thanks. That's all I need.
::'''Damian:''' Safe travels, friend from afar. You're always welcome at the Sorrentino Inn.
::'''Damian:''' 
----
;(After completing the side quest, [[The Last Knight]])
;(Idle)
:{{DIcon}}Alright, my first time leaving Egla Town... Ugh, still a bit nervous after all.
:{{DIcon}}Stay calm, Damian. Calmness and bravery are a knight's virtues... No way I should lose to Carlow.
;(Chat)
:'''Damian:''' Hello, {{Rover}}! I didn't expect to see you here!
:'''Damian:''' I'm currently on vacation, but if you need to book a room, you can contact Uncle Cosimo directly.
:{{DIcon}}: Where are you headed?
::'''Damian:''' For my first stop... I'm heading to Ragunna City to admire the Cathedral and the statue of Sentinel Imperator.
::'''Damian:''' After that, I plan to explore the legendary sites where the knights were knighted. Carlow mentioned that s omewhere in Rinascita, the legendary sword still stands, year after year, waiting for its master to return...
:{{DIcon}}: Do you really dislike Carlow?
::'''Damian:''' No, even though we often argued when we were kids, I've always admired Carlow for openly sharing his dreams of becoming a knight.
::'''Damian:''' The Night Reveries' conclusion left me a bit surprised by his change... so I gathered the courage to approach Uncle Cosimo with my request.
::'''Damian:''' I was surprised when he readily agreed, saying that young people should always go out and see the world.
:{{DIcon}}: Have a wonderful journey, see you soon!
::'''Damian:''' Goodbye, {{Rover}}. May you find what you seek on your journey. 
{{Dialogue End}}
